# tcs-curriculum

Plans a course outline only — measurable Bloom-level objectives, learning path, modules, lessons, durations and pace — into curriculum.yaml, and prioritizes a long topic list or course catalogue (spreadsheet) with the impact × frequency × gap × urgency × compliance method, audience quotas, subject dedupe and tiers.

Part of the **[Training Content Studio](../training-content-studio/README.md)** plugin.

## What it's for
Turn a topic (and optional sources) or a catalogue of candidates into a validated `curriculum.yaml`: what learners will be
able to do, in which order, in which lessons, how long, in which format — with a recorded reason for every choice.
It is the planning step that tcs-orchestrator (interactive) and tcs-autopilot (Stage 3) call; it can also be used alone.

## When to use it
- Use when someone asks to "plan / outline / structure a curriculum", "write learning objectives", "which courses should we build first", "prioritize this catalogue" or "rank these topics".
- **Not for:** producing lessons, scripts or videos (tcs-orchestrator or tcs-autopilot) and not for ingesting source documents (tcs-source-ingest).

## Install
```bash
# whole plugin (recommended: scripts use the shared schemas/, kit/, assets/)
git clone https://github.com/TamerElsherif/tamer-skills && claude --plugin-dir tamer-skills/training-content-studio
# this skill only (instructions only; its scripts need the plugin root)
npx skills add TamerElsherif/tamer-skills --skill tcs-curriculum --agent claude-code
```
Prerequisites: Python 3.12 venv with `tools/requirements.txt` (plugin root); keys via env or `TCS_ENV_FILE` (`OPENAI_API_KEY` for narration/transcription, `PEXELS_API_KEY` optional); Node 18+ and ffmpeg for video renders.

## How to use
```
/tcs-curriculum <request or file>
```
**Inputs**

- Topic / request text; audience (roles, level), languages; total length if given.
- Optional `sources.yaml` (from tcs-source-ingest) — headings, procedures, policies seed the objectives.
- Optional candidate list: `.xlsx` / `.csv` catalogue (read-only) or `candidates.yaml`.
- Optional domain pack name (`domains/<pack>/`) for prioritization weights, quotas, clusters, glossary.

**Outputs**

- `curriculum.yaml` — validates against `schemas/curriculum.schema.json` (course, objectives, modules → lessons,
  optional `prioritization`, `approval`).
- Optional `prioritization.md` — ranked table for the approval gate.

## Examples
**Example 1: Prioritize a catalogue**
Prompt: `rank this 216-course catalogue and pick the top 20 for staff, IT and executives`
Result: Scores impact × frequency × gap × urgency × compliance with pack weights, dedupes subjects, applies audience quotas, tiers the rest with reasons → curriculum.yaml.

**Example 2: Outline only**
Prompt: `outline a 3-module onboarding course with objectives and durations`
Result: Writes measurable Bloom objectives, modules, lessons and durations without producing content.

## Layout
```
tcs-curriculum/
  SKILL.md
  references/
    objectives-and-paths.md
    prioritization.md
  scripts/
    prioritize.py
    test_prioritize.py
    validate_curriculum.py
  templates/
    curriculum.template.yaml
    prioritization.default.yaml
    prioritization.security-awareness.yaml
```
